label: Exchange
description: An exchange listing Stellar-based assets, typically running its own validator and/or Horizon/RPC infrastructure for deposit/withdrawal reliability.
typicalInfrastructure: Self-run stellar-core, Horizon, and/or RPC nodes
Hot/cold wallet infrastructure interacting directly with the network
Automated deposit crediting based on ledger data
questionsToAsk: Have we scheduled the node/Horizon/RPC upgrade before the stated deadline?
Does this release change resource usage, fees, or behavior our deposit-crediting logic assumes?
Do we need to pause deposits/withdrawals during the upgrade window?
